sailors.biography:
Pavlos is an Olympic Medalist together with Panagiotis Mantis in the 470 category at the
RIO2016 Olympic Games, winning the Bronze Medal.
At the Olympic Games in Tokyo 2021 were ranked in 8th place.
He has been ranked #1 in the World Rankings and has won 1 Gold and 2 Silver medals in
European Championship and 2 Bronze in World Championships as well as in international
competitions and World Cups. He has been a member of the Men's National Team since
2006 as he was also an athlete of the National Team in the youth categories. He was Born
in 1984 in Thessaloniki and started sailing in the age of 7 in the then Porto Carras Nautical
Club and has passed over the years from the Thessaloniki Sailing Club, Yacht Club of
Greece, Vouliagmeni Citizens Nautical Club and today continues his career in Piraeus
Sailing Club. Today he competes in the 49er category as well as in offshore races and
Match Race. Apart from racing activity, he was a member of Hellenic Olympic Committee
as a representative of Athletes from 2017-2021, while today he is a member of the
European Olympic Committee representative all European Athletes.
sailors.name: Pavlos Serafeim Kagialis

sailors.biography:
My name is José Manuel Ruiz Ibáñez, I am a 21-year-old high-level athlete from Murcia, Spain.
I started sailing at the age of 8 together with my grandfather in Mar Menor, Murcia.
Since 2019 I have been a member of the Spanish National Team in ILCA7 and 49er Olympic Categories.
Currently, I am in 3rd year of Physiotherapy at UCAM with a sports scholarship that allows to race while I study.
Since I was little I have been a lover of the sea and sports wellness. I have always been linked to sports and health.
I consider myself a person with deep-rooted sports values, among which competitiveness, sportsmanship, sacrifice, dedication, efficiency, perseverance, respect...
sailors.name: Jose Manuel Ruiz Ibanez
